test_DogmaticList_init: test that DogmaticList initializes as an empty list or from an existing list
test_DogmaticList_immutability: test that DogmaticList rejects append, extend, insert, sort, reverse, setitem, delitem, iadd, and imul mutations
test_DogmaticList_getitem: test that DogmaticList supports read-only indexing including negative indices
test_DogmaticList_revelation: test that DogmaticList revelation returns an empty set for plain values and nested DogmaticDict keys
test_DogmaticList_list_interface: test that DogmaticList supports len, count, and index read-only list interface methods
